source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check power status via IPMI command: ipmitool -I lanplus -H <BMC IP> -U <BMC username> -P <BMC password> chassis power status

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Power status should be displayed correctly.

deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: returns FULL raw `ipmitool (OOB lanplus) chassis status`; user judges.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES changes the canonical Master `chassis power status` to broader `chassis status`, exposes password arguments and leaves raw user judgment without parsed enum, target association or freshness.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE / CHANGED after command resolution, secret-safe execution, exact BMC/SUT identity, enum parsing and fail-closed freshness checks.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 981/2291 accepts direct raw output without resolving command/schema or automated acceptance.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Power on/off and soft-off cases are state-changing; their evidence cannot replace this narrow read-only status query.

original_test_intent: Read and display the correct BMC-reported SUT chassis power state without changing power.
original_method: Verify BMC-to-SUT identity, execute the canonical protected `chassis power status` query with timeout, parse the approved state enum and freshness metadata, optionally correlate a second read-only source, and return redacted structured evidence.
manual_activity: Owner validates command/schema, target association and allowed enums once; normal execution and deterministic parsing need no per-run confirmation, while only exceptions return to the engineer.
required_inputs: Accepted state enum and freshness timeout
safety_requirements: Do not issue chassis power on/off/cycle/soft or any write action.
Use the Master power-status query unless an approved equivalent is documented.
Keep credentials out of process arguments and evidence.
Fail closed on timeout, error, unknown/multiple/stale states or target mismatch.
Do not infer AC presence, workload health or physical condition from BMC power state.
agent_execution_scope: Resolve exact BMC/SUT identity and protected session.
Run the approved read-only power-status query once with timeout.
Parse completion and state enum with timestamp/freshness.
Optionally correlate Redfish/WebUI without overriding canonical evidence.
Return structured redacted evidence and no DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve command, association, channel/cipher and enum.
Review only ambiguous/conflicting exceptions and set formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Broader `chassis status` is not automatically equivalent to Master `chassis power status`; password CLI and raw human judgment also fail secret and deterministic-parser requirements.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use secret-safe protected `chassis power status` with bounded timeout, explicit enum parsing and target/freshness validation.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Master power-status command, Script, Criterion and 5/10-minute values remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run the canonical protected read-only query and automatically validate one fresh approved power-state token.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Any Project SUT with validated BMC/IPMI association and schema.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Pin BMC, IPMI/ipmitool, parser and Script revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform BMC/IPMI chassis power-status semantics and Project target map.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds secret-safe transport, deterministic parsing, target/freshness checks and optional correlation while retaining the canonical query.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: This covers management-reported power state only, not physical AC, boot/workload health or power-transition functionality.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Command/schema, association, enums, credentials and timeout.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A stale BMC response may not match physical condition; secret leakage is possible with password arguments.

project_override_considerations: An alternate Redfish or vendor read requires engineer-approved state equivalence, timestamp/freshness and disclosure that Master IPMI-command coverage remains unverified if omitted.
expected_evidence: BMC/SUT identity and protected session metadata
Redacted raw completion/output for canonical query
Parsed state enum with timestamp and freshness result
No-write/no-clear audit and engineer-owned final verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master Procedure and Criteria coherently request one read-only power-status query. The differing DeepSeek command is review guidance and is not accepted as a source conflict.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Purpose and canonical method are clear; target, schema, credentials and freshness are execution-readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Restores canonical command, protects credentials and adds deterministic enum/freshness validation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Independently supports fully automatable classification after setup.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces raw user judgment with fail-closed machine-verifiable acceptance.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Maintains strict read-only separation from power transition tests.

review_improvement: Makes a narrow status read safely automatable without leaking secrets, changing power or mistaking broader/stale output for the canonical state.
independent_technical_reasoning: The canonical IPMI power-status command produces a small enumerable state suitable for deterministic automation. Correctness still depends on target association, command completion and freshness; successful exit or `chassis status` text is insufficient, and BMC state cannot establish AC presence or workload health.
